title: Carelevo first Suspend pump attempt fails while temp basal or extended bolus is active
body:
Description

Build version
- 4.0.0-dev-a (d01e) (branch: carelevo)

Time of issue
- Reproduced repeatedly during testing on July 24, 2026

Environment
- Device / OS: Galaxy S25 (Android 16)
- Branch: carelevo
- Frequency: 100%

Precondition
- Patch is connected
- A temp basal or extended bolus is currently running

Steps to reproduce
1. Start a temp basal or extended bolus.
2. Confirm on the Home screen that the infusion is in progress.
3. Navigate to the Carelevo Overview screen
4. On the patch info screen, tap `Suspend pump`.
5. Set a suspend duration and confirm.

Expected behavior
- Suspend pump should succeed on the first attempt.
- All running infusions should stop.
- The patch/pump should be shown as suspended.

Actual behavior
- The first suspend attempt fails and a failure toast is shown.
- However, the running temp basal or extended bolus is actually stopped.
- After that, a second suspend attempt usually succeeds.

Additional note
- This issue is easier to reproduce when `Suspend pump` is triggered while a temp basal or extended bolus is active.
- In practice, the first attempt fails, and from the second attempt onward it tends to succeed.

Logs
- Relevant logs will be attached.

comments.body:
A possible fix has been prepared in commit : 2c7f5f9ff481ca0d8d527d1864a304bb44734d2c

Could you please review and confirm whether this approach looks acceptable?

Verified with https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/0e1a25b47f75ed7913c291701725129dc015a582.
This issue is confirmed fixed on our side.
